title: Add Comic Book Scene maker to Orphaned Sun Foundry tools

phases.title: Comic scene data model, upload pipeline, layouts, and tile export
Add the Comic Book Scene tab and interactive panel controls
Style the comic builder and document the workflow
Validate package contents and publish module 0.3.0

finalChecks.name: Module manifest parses
finalChecks.run: node -e "const m=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('module.json','utf8')); if(m.version!=='0.3.0') throw new Error('expected module 0.3.0');"

finalChecks.name: Comic export defaults panels to hidden
finalChecks.run: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('scripts/comic-book-maker.mjs','utf8'); if(!s.includes('hidden: true')) throw new Error('hidden comic panel export missing'); if(!s.includes('fit: \"cover\"')) throw new Error('cover-fit panel texture missing');"

finalChecks.name: Comic UI and assets are packaged
finalChecks.run: test -s templates/scene-library.hbs && test -s assets/comic/paper.svg && test -s assets/comic/frame.svg && grep -q 'Comic Book Scene' templates/scene-library.hbs
